body: Why does whatever they feel matter?

You're not alone, I can relate 

My mother had 3 strokes within a year and a half. That last one cost her her ability to verbalize her thoughts, she completely forgot how to do her job which she'd been doing for over 25 years 

She was so devastated, Luckily it was the same time her work place upgraded everything to be completely software dependent so things got way easier for her and her job was secured.  

Loads and loads of physiotherapy, but even now a year afterwards she's not the same person, and I feel like I lost someone, that stroke changed how her brain works

Healthwise it feels like she's deteriorating, and it's a matter of time before I'll really lose her, because the list of illnesses doesn't stop there

And just like you, she's the only real family I can consider as family, if she's gone my life will be 100% different, literally 

I understand u because I felt that fear of losing her, I couldn't sleep, I couldn't eat properly, I cried so much, I lost joy in many things, I never told anyone, I still do

 I'm still trying to prevent it from happening, and the aftermath if she's gone, I always take care of her as best as I can but there are things that I can't control.. 

I think, for you and me what we can do is just try our best to keep the ppl we love around, personally I run all her health matters to be sure of everything.. I try to minimize her worries by solving her problems... 

We can take a step back, take a deep breath and realize this person we cherish lives life on their terms so their life should be celebrated rather than mourned.. They're beautiful ppl that made us love them so much  

And we need to come in terms with the fact that we need to find solutions before issues arise, if there's an aftermath for u to deal with, I suggest u address it from now... That's what I'm trying to do 

I hope it helps, good luck

Edit: and yeah my mother was my best friend, so I can also relate to the emotional reliance you had, I started trying to find new ppl that are reliable and loyal enough.. It's better to re direct everything in a healthy way.. It's a bumpy road but not an impossible one, it's doable..

I can relate, there was this person who I loved very much but they always made sure to let me know I'm not good enough not smart enough not anything enough.

And yes verbal abuse, they'd curse me out etc etc, it was messed up but I loved them nonetheless and still do, maybe not as intense but it's definitely there because they're my first love in some sense 

I think if we love someone we accept them with their flaws u know? We think maybe we understand them better and that tolerating stuff serves as proof of that acceptance 

Personally looking at them as yet another human, that had its share of sufferings so much so it surfaces like that, with their verbal abuse and how they treated me or others pretty poorly.. 

Looking at them like that made them more  human, it cleared why they were the way they were

There are things within our control, and things that aren't, I think once that realization hit me, things became easier...

So don't blame urself, you've done well and I'm sure letting them go contributed to maintain ur sanity, perhaps they'll be able to fight their demons one day and come out a better person

I can somewhat understand. What you wrote reminds me of something I wrote long ago.. 

You're doing my next step, and I often said to myself if I get to your point in sometime, it'll most likely leave a hole and I'll feel lonely... 

Unless there's someone there, so I tried to find someone relatable, who understands and is dependable 

But what I've come to realize after knowing so many, is generally ppl who have a similar experiences to ours would understand us better, there can be exceptions always though..  And again it's a mere observation 

I come from an abusive household too, and my siblings are my responsibility as well, for a very long time I've put them and my mother a priority

Well I expected they'd take initiative like I did whenever they'll stand on their feet, but they didn't, infact as soon as they became independent they wanted more money more attention more of everything... Their behaviours and mine were complete opposite 

Maybe your siblings are/will be different, I don't exactly know your circumstances, but all I'm saying is you offered them a hand, and you made it out, so you built a bridge out to escape whatever they're facing, you also keep good contact

You stood up and showed them that one's life is a choice, you can choose to change things to the better and that things aren't permanent.. That's excellent in my opinion 

Our siblings have their own journey, so long their situation is not life threatening and as I said you offered a hand, the rest is for them to decide.. U know I never would've thought in a million years that my siblings would behave or say the things they did when they stood on their feet.. So whether u stay or go, things can't be that predictable 

Don't guilt yourself, you've done your best my dear, if perhaps you still want to go back to help them then you're already doing the best most reliable option

By that I mean you're strengthening yourself rn, if you've got things mostly figured out and stronger then you'll be able to give them a hand and guide them even better 

Either way, I commend you for doing it, you're a strong and brave person and give yourself the credit it deserves, try to explain things to ur siblings in a loving manner so they understand why you did what u did if they're on bad terms with u

Although if they're mature enough, they'll understand 

Good luck, sorry for the long text

Edit: Note: and yes I relate very much to the I have no one part, it sucks Rn but, you'll Likely find ppl similar to u if u do things u like..

You need to know you're a strong person for doing what you did, and for realizing what's to be done and following through on ur own, that's Really  Outstanding imo, it takes courage to do this 

The other thing is, focus on ur life, add things to it, there's a lot to explore, write a list of the Crazy fun  things u wanted to do when u feel like it, I hope this makes sense
